name: swarm-studio-dev
description: Development checks only (the type check, the dependency rules, the orphan checks (dependency-cruiser for the studio's own code, knip for the next UI), the design-token build, the UI audit gates, the property tests in tests/property/ (fast-check, decision 0019), the metamorphic relations in tests/metamorphic/ and the OpenSpec scenarios in tests/bdd/ (playwright-bdd, decision 0019); the :ui scripts run the next UI's own, from ui/package.json). It lives here, not at the plugin's root, so `hermes plugins install` finds no package.json to offer to install: the plugin installs nothing from it.

scripts.orphans: cd ../.. && depcruise web engine server tests scripts bench packs desktop tools/dev/audit tools/dev/bdd tools/dev/tokens.mjs tools/dev/playwright.config.mjs tools/dev/bdd.config.mjs docs/ux/frames/src docs/ux/statechart --config .dependency-cruiser-orphans.mjs --ignore-known .dependency-cruiser-orphans-known.json
scripts.bdd: node ../../tests/bdd/gen.mjs && bddgen -c bdd.config.mjs && playwright test -c bdd.config.mjs
